result: FAIL overall: iPad18.5 functional UI passed; iPhone16.0 still failed after observed Close tap. No all-iOS acceptance.

platforms.name: iPhone16.0
platforms.failure: After actual native Close tap, ActivityListView still exists at20s. Failure screenshot still shows full sheet. Selector omission alone does not explain this run.

diagnosis: iOS16 actual Close has no identifier; iPad18.5 does have header.closeButton, disproving a blanket legacy-identifier claim
Close must be awaited as hittable explicitly; collecting debugDescription before a tap can incidentally mask presentation readiness races
SwiftUI ActivitySheet had no UIKit completion callback clearing its presentation item. Connecting completion with matching UUID is a candidate fix, not yet a proven root cause.

candidateFix.scope: Explicit Close readiness, no application-wide swipe, matching-ID sharing completion/error handling, stale callback regression; targeted2-platform trial must be checked completed before integration

limits: Diagnostic workflow is not for main
